cards.ex: I've got an itch to travel now that I've finished my studies.
cards.exUz: O'qishni tugatganimdan keyin sayohat qilishga juda ham ishtiyoqim bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga juda ham istaging borligi, sabrsizlanishing.

cards.ex: He sets great store by academic achievement.
cards.exUz: U ilmiy yutuqlarga katta ahamiyat beradi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir katta ahamiyat bermoq, qadrlamoq.

cards.ex: I'd love to have a shot at running my own business.
cards.exUz: O'z biznesimni boshqarishga urinib ko'rishni juda xohlardim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga imkoniyatga ega bo'lmoq, urinib ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: She's hell-bent on getting into Harvard.
cards.exUz: U Harvardga kirishga qattiq bel bog'lagan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga qat'iy qaror qilmoq, juda ishtiyoq bilan harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: He has a burning ambition to become a doctor.
cards.exUz: Uning shifokor bo'lishga yonuvchi istagi bor.
cards.uzDef: Kuchli va doimiy istak, orzu.

cards.ex: I felt a strong urge to quit my job and travel the world.
cards.exUz: Ishimni tashlab, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishga kuchli xohish sezdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli istak, qattiq xohish.

cards.ex: Curiosity was the driving force behind his research.
cards.exUz: Qiziquvchanlik uning tadqiqotlari ortidagi harakatlantiruvchi kuch edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga undaydigan asosiy sabab, kuch.

cards.ex: Many young artists aspire to greatness, but few achieve it.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina yosh rassomlar buyuklikka intilishadi, ammo ularning ozchiligi bunga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yutuqlarga erishishga harakat qilmoq, buyuk bo'lishni orzu qilmoq.

cards.ex: She's set her heart on winning the competition.
cards.exUz: U musobaqada g'alaba qozonishga ko'ngil qo'ygan.
cards.uzDef: Nimani juda xohlash, butun vujuding bilan istamoq.

cards.ex: He clearly has designs on her job.
cards.exUz: Uning aniq ravishda uning ishiga ko'z olaytirgan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir olishni xohlamoq, nimagadir ko'z olaytirmoq.

cards.ex: She felt a deep yearning for her homeland.
cards.exUz: U o'z vatanini chuqur sog'inch bilan his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga erishishni juda xohlash, juda sog'inish.

cards.ex: He's bent on proving them wrong.
cards.exUz: U ularning xato ekanligini isbotlashga qasd qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga qattiq qaror qilmoq, qasd qilmoq.

cards.ex: He's trying to make a name for himself in the fashion industry.
cards.exUz: U moda sanoatida o'ziga nom qozonishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida mashhur bo'lmoq, nom qozonmoq.

cards.ex: He's out for revenge.
cards.exUz: U qasos olish uchun harakatda.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir olish uchun harakatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: His plan to become a millionaire by 30 is just a pipedream.
cards.exUz: Uning 30 yoshga qadar millioner bo'lish rejasi shunchaki amalga oshmas orzu.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan orzu, xayol.

cards.ex: I have my eye on that new car.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha yangi mashinaga ko'zimni tikdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga ko'z tikmoq, nimadir xohlamoq.

cards.ex: I'm dying to go to that concert.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha konsertga borishni juda xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimani juda kuchli xohlamoq, o'lishga tayyor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: She's very keen on learning to play the guitar.
cards.exUz: U gitara chalishni o'rganishga juda ishtiyoqi baland.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga juda xohishi bor, ishtiyoqi baland.

cards.ex: I would jump at the chance to work abroad.
cards.exUz: Men chet elda ishlash imkoniyatini qo'ldan bermas edim.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyat paydo bo'lganda, uni darhol qabul qilish.

cards.ex: She longs to see her family again.
cards.exUz: U oilasini yana ko'rishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga kuchli istak bilan intilmoq, sog'inmoq.

cards.ex: I have the ambition to write a novel.
cards.exUz: Menda roman yozishga intilish bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun katta istakka ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He craves for recognition of his work.
cards.exUz: U o'z ishining tan olinishini qattiq xohlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimani juda xohlamoq, ehtiyoj sezmoq.

cards.ex: He's consumed by his ambition.
cards.exUz: Uni uning ambitsiyasi egallab olgan.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay biror narsa bilan band bo'lib qolmoq, fikrlari egallab olmoq.

cards.ex: You should pursue your dreams, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Siz nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, orzularingizni amalga oshirishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Orzularga erishish uchun harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She has a burning passion for music.
cards.exUz: Uning musiqaga yonayotgan ishtiyoqi bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va davomiy ishtiyoq.

cards.ex: He's driven by a desire to help others.
cards.exUz: U boshqalarga yordam berish istagi bilan haydalgan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga kuchli istak bilan undalmoq.

cards.ex: He has a longing for adventure.
cards.exUz: Uning sarguzashtga istagi bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir juda xohlamoq, istagi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Keep your eyes peeled for any opportunities.
cards.exUz: Har qanday imkoniyat uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan kuzatib turmoq, nimadir uchun ehtiyot bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Always aim for the top in everything you do.
cards.exUz: Har doim qilgan ishingizda eng yuqoriga intiling.
cards.uzDef: Eng yuqori natijalarga erishishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The team is really fired up for the game.
cards.exUz: Jamoa o'yin uchun juda ilhomlangan.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'ayratli va ilhomlangan bo'lmoq.
